description: Speak Now. She wrote this whole thing alone, no co-writers, and that's actually impressive. I built my career off being an auteur too, so I recognize the grind. But it's country pop, and I'm from Chicago, this is barn territory. The storytelling is sharp though, Enchanted and Dear John are real. I respect the solo vision. Still not Yeezy, but not bad for a girl with a guitar.
